title: Ideation Arena: Evaluating LLM Generated Research Ideas with Battle-style Human Expert Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.29696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating research ideas generated by LLMs is difficult because their scientific value cannot be fully determined by objective criteria, and no single reference answer specifies what counts as a good idea. To address this challenge, we introduce Ideation Arena, a battle style platform that evaluates research ideas through pairwise human assessment. Ideation Arena evaluates ideas generated by 14 frontier LLMs and 5 research agent architectures built on 2 base models. To ensure a common starting point, Ideation Arena builds shared literature contexts from papers familiar to the participating researchers and provides the same contexts to all LLMs and agents. We collect over 6,000 double blind pairwise comparisons from 105 active computer science researchers and construct an Elo rating leaderboard of proposal-stage expert preferences in computer science under a shared closed-context protocol. translated_title: Ideation Arena：通过对战式人类专家评估来评价大语言模型生成的研究想法
translated_abstract: 评估由大语言模型（LLM）生成的研究想法十分困难，因为其科学价值无法完全通过客观标准来判定，也不存在唯一的参考答案来界定什么才算是一个好想法。为了应对这一挑战，我们推出了Ideation Arena，一个通过成对人类专家评估来评价研究想法的对战式平台。Ideation Arena评估了由14个前沿大语言模型以及基于2个基础模型构建的5种研究智能体架构所生成的想法。为了确保共同的起点，Ideation Arena从参与评估的研究人员所熟悉的论文中构建了共享的文献背景，并向所有大语言模型和智能体提供相同的背景信息。我们从105位活跃的计算机科学研究人员那里收集了超过6,000次双盲成对比较，并在共享封闭上下文协议下，构建了计算机科学领域提案阶段专家偏好的Elo评分排行榜。我们通过评分者间一致性验证了排名的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出Ideation Arena对战式评估平台，在统一的封闭文献背景下，通过105位计算机科学研究者的6000余次双盲成对比较，对14个前沿大语言模型和5种研究智能体生成的研究想法进行专家评估，并建立了提案阶段专家偏好的Elo评分排行榜。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Ideation Arena, a battle-style platform that evaluates research ideas generated by 14 frontier LLMs and 5 research agent architectures through over 6,000 double-blind pairwise comparisons from 105 active computer science researchers, establishing an Elo rating leaderboard of expert preferences under a shared closed-context protocol.
